amount.description: What it settled, in the invoice's currency.

base.description: The invoice's carrying amount it cleared, in the base currency: the amount at the invoice's stored rate, and for the part that settles what is left of an invoice, what was left (ENG-14).

realised_fx.description: The realised gain (positive) or loss (negative) in the base currency: the amount at the receipt's rate against the invoice's stored rate, with no tolerance (ENG-41).

tolerance.description: For an invoice received in full with a little less: the carrying amount the settlement difference cleared to 7030, in the base currency (FR-BNK-08).
